name: codemium
description: Persistent coding intelligence for Codex: project memory, bounded working sets, scoped engineering, impact-aware testing, and deterministic reuse.

interface.shortDescription: The senior engineer who already knows your codebase.
interface.longDescription: Codemium gives Codex persistent project intelligence. It maintains durable architecture and engineering knowledge, builds lightweight repository maps, compiles scoped task contracts, selects bounded working sets, enforces minimum justified engineering, maps change impact to tests, detects scope pollution, reuses deterministic work on unchanged state, and stops when sufficient evidence proves completion.
defaultPrompt: Use Codemium for this coding task: understand the project, select a bounded working set, make the smallest justified change, verify according to risk, preserve scope, and stop when proven.
Use Codemium project intelligence. Reuse durable project knowledge and unchanged deterministic work instead of relearning the repository.
